title: EasyDryve Firestore Schema
description: Collection and document shapes for Cloud Firestore backend.

documentId.description: Auto-generated Firestore document id; treated as opaque string in the app.

dateTime.description: ISO-8601 datetime string (reference app); ports may use native Timestamp if mapped consistently.

alarmOffsetMinutes.description: Minutes before dateTime to fire reminder; null means no alarm; 0 means at trip time.

indexes.notes: Reference app orders newest/latest first; client may also sort in memory.

securityRulesSketch: allow read, write: if request.auth != null;
// Tighten to ownerUid == request.auth.uid when multi-user is added.

seedBehavior.when: collection is empty on first repository load
